name: Garment shop
intro: If you sell clothes on credit to regular customers, or take stock from suppliers on credit, BolCash helps you keep both records on your phone.

uses.title: Customer udhar
uses.body: Note down what each customer still has to pay.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your cloth and garment suppliers, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
